propositions: A declared-none file-impact ticket should retain certified status after unrelated HEAD moves, without requiring re-hashing of dependencies.

An empty dependency map with explicit file_impact_scope: none must classify as 'none' and skip whole-HEAD freshness checks, while undeclared empty maps remain unscoped and fall back to whole-HEAD stale-head verdict.
The manifest must emit exactly one authenticated 'file-scope: none' declaration only for none scope; paths and unscoped outputs must be byte-identical to pre-feature behavior.
Scope flips or no_file_impact_reason changes must invalidate the signed material fingerprint with stale-material verdict.
Recovery via resign_plan_review must preserve the authenticated none-scope declaration through the signing boundary without requiring ticket-store reads in manifest.py.
